title: The loop again
summary: Jordan learned their role was "under evaluation" during a flat, corporate one-on-one with Marcus, and reacted by leaving work early, isolating at home, and canceling lunch plans with Dev. After spending the evening with Pepper and then Mika—who showed up unannounced with food and comfort rather than questions—Jordan felt the emotional gears "unsticking a little," recognizing a familiar pattern where work setbacks trigger withdrawal until someone from outside pulls them back. Jordan decided to go to Groundwork the next day.
